chapter: Drumming days and neighborhood life, 1919 onward
title: Fish fries on Friday nights and a brother's gig
summary: Dejan recalls younger brother Wilbert on drums at a fish fry, and how Friday fish fries worked with a red lantern outside and musicians sitting in.
